claim_summary: The full Hamming enumerator is a specified three-term cubic-power-trace polynomial, with \(A_4(m)=3m\) for every \(m\ge10\) and a complete small-size exception list.
integrity: Exact symbolic transfer and finite independent direct enumerations; no external independent audit or claimed publication.
object: Additive trace-Hermitian self-dual \(\mathbb F_4\) wheel graph code on \(m+1\) coordinates for every integer \(m\ge3\)
scientific_limitations: Specific standard wheel additive code only; no general stabilizer-code optimality, noise threshold, or full-text priority certainty for one bordered-circulant paper. The previously known six-qubit wheel example is explicitly credited.
title: A cubic-trace weight enumerator and eventual \(3m\) low-weight law for wheel graph codes
